title: TESS eclipses occur within 2 sigma of the conjunction times of Gaia DR3 astrometric orbits (P < 200 d), but only 0.6-0.8 times as often as the Gaia inclinations predict
abstract: Question: Gaia DR3 astrometric orbits give inclinations and conjunction times. Do TESS eclipses occur at the predicted times and at the predicted rate? Method: For 10,331 Gaia DR3 sources with Thiele-Innes orbits and P < 200 d, we drew parameters from the full Gaia covariance and calculated the eclipse probability, depth and conjunction times. We searched TESS QLP/TESS-SPOC light curves (sectors 1-107) of 789 stars with G < 14 (357 high, 284 mid, 148 control in eclipse probability) for single dips. We used a random-phase null, a common-mode veto, injection-recovery efficiency (1,600 injections) and visual vetting. The rate test uses 133 stars whose Gaia timing is precise (3 sigma_t <= P/8). Results: The 22 vetted eclipses in these stars occur at the Gaia conjunction times with rms z = 1.03 and all |z| < 2 (offsets 0.06-7 d). For AstroSpectroSB1 solutions the deeper eclipse is at the predicted primary-behind node in 13 of 16 systems (p = 0.02). With the measured efficiency, the Gaia predictions give 34.3 eclipses; we see 22 vetted (plus 3 uncertain), or 26.1 above the null with automatic detections (expected 32.1). The high group gives 18 vetted against 32.0 expected, the mid group 4 against 2.2, and the timed control 0 against 0. A fit with a scale k on all Gaia uncertainties and a residual efficiency eps gives k = 1, eps = 0.90 (0.75-1.05) for automatic detections. For vetted detections, k = 1 with eps = 1 is disfavoured (Delta ln L = -5.4); the data need eps = 0.7 or inclination errors 1.5-3 times too small. We list 72 vetted eclipsing binaries with Gaia astrometric orbits (P 3.9-198 d); 4 are TOIs, none is in the Gaia DR3 EB table. Conclusion: Gaia conjunction times are reliable within their errors. Users should expect about 60-80% of the formal Gaia eclipse probability for edge-on selections. Limitations: simple stellar radii and companion masses, subjective vetting, box injections without the veto, only 133 timed stars, VSX/SIMBAD not checked.
